build_huggingface_hub_package: build the huggingface_hub python package with setuptools and find_packages from src directory
install_huggingface_hub_dependencies: install huggingface_hub core dependencies including filelock fsspec httpx pyyaml tqdm and typer
install_huggingface_hub_extras: install huggingface_hub extras like torch oauth gradio mcp testing quality and typing
run_huggingface_cli_commands: run huggingface_hub console scripts hf huggingface-cli and tiny-agents from entry points
register_hf_filesystem_fsspec: register hf filesystem spec with fsspec for huggingface hub file access
